summary: Master procurement negotiation and TCO analysis with BATNA, ZOPA, scorecards, and Excel-based worksheets for stronger sourcing results.
lede: Procurement negotiation and Total Cost of Ownership analysis help buying teams compare suppliers beyond quoted price. For procurement officers, category managers, sourcing specialists and contract administrators, the course builds practical skills in RFQ and RFP evaluation, negotiation and concession planning, and lifecycle cost modeling. Learners practice creating supplier scorecards, reviewing cost-affecting contract terms, comparing award options, and reporting savings.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with suppliers, purchasing data, or contract terms and need stronger negotiation and cost-analysis capability. It suits people who want practical procurement outputs they can use immediately in sourcing, award, and reporting work.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software installed and a basic understanding of sourcing or purchasing documents. If your organization uses RFQ, RFP, supplier scorecards, or contract trackers, those artefacts will help you connect the exercises to your day-to-day work.
